fusions.name: Thundering Front
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Ridden Under
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Gallop Cadence
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds. You have +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Timing
fusions.desc: Every few tiles you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
